source_caption:
The Star Wars saga changed cinema forever by turning a space adventure into a modern mythology. George Lucas drew from samurai films, Westerns, Flash Gordon serials, and Joseph Campbell’s hero’s journey to create a universe where lightsabers, the Force, and the battle between hope and darkness became part of global pop culture.

Star Wars created by George Lucas, starring Mark Hamill, Harrison Ford, Carrie Fisher. A legendary space opera spanning generations of heroes, villains, rebels, Jedi, and Sith, blending myth, adventure, family legacy, and galactic conflict into one of the most influential franchises in film history.
